items.title: 5.5 Elastic bigaar, plastic bigaar aur elastic limit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.5 with Fig. 5.5 and Example 5.1 (PDF 98-99).

blocks.text: Tensile test mein metal ki wire ko ek muqarrar raftar se kheencha jata hai, aur kheenchne ke doran wire mein paida hone wala stress machine mein lagi ek electronic device lagatar napti rehti hai. Force-elongation (force aur lambai ke izafe ka) diagram ya stress-strain curve X-Y chart recorder par khud ban jata hai. Ductile material ka aam stress-strain curve Fig. 5.5 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Stress (sigma) ka Strain ke muqable graph, origin O se. Curve O se A tak seedhi lakeer mein uthta hai, B par murta hai, aahista uth kar sab se oonche nuqte C tak jata hai aur phir D tak gir kar khatam hota hai. A, B aur C par chhote daire hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Ek aam ductile maadde ka stress-strain curve (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O se A tak stress aur strain barabar nisbat mein barhte hain (Hooke's law), is liye OA seedhi lakeer hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein O ke qareeb lakeer thori muri hui chhapi hai; text ke mutabiq yahan seedhi banai gayi hai. B elastic limit (yield point), C sab se zyada stress (UTS) aur D toot jane ka point hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 5.5 mein curve O ke paas muri hui chhapi hai, halan ke text kehta hai ke A tak (proportional limit) stress aur strain barabar nisbat mein hain, yani OA seedhi lakeer honi chahiye. Oopar OA seedhi banai gayi hai.

Deformation ke shuru mein stress strain ke saath seedhi nisbat (linearly) mein barhta hai, curve ke point A tak. Ise proportional limit (σₚ) kehte hain: woh sab se zyada stress jis tak stress aur strain ki seedhi lakeer wali nisbat qaim rehti hai. Hooke's law kehta hai ke strain (deformation) stress (force ya load) ke seedha proportional hai; yeh law hissa OA mein lagu hota hai. A se B tak stress aur strain proportional nahi rehte.

Agar O aur B ke darmiyan kisi bhi point par load hata diya jaye to curve usi raste wapas aata hai aur material apni asal lambai par aa jata hai. Hissa OB mein material elastic hai. Point B ko yield point kehte hain, aur B par stress ki value elastic limit σₑ kehlati hai.

Agar stress yield stress (elastic limit) se aage barhaya jaye to namoona (specimen) hamesha ke liye badal jata hai: stress hatane ke baad bhi apni asal shakal ya size mein wapas nahi aata. Is rawayye ko plasticity kehte hain. Curve ka B se C tak hissa plasticity ka hai. Point C material ki ultimate tensile strength (UTS) σᵤ hai: woh sab se zyada stress jo material bardasht kar sakta hai; ise material ki nominal strength (asal mazbooti) bhi keh sakte hain. Point C paar hone ke baad material point D par toot jata hai; D par stress fracture stress (σf) hai.
Jo cheezein tootne tak plastic deformation sahti rehti hain (khinch kar lambi hoti rehti hain) unhen ductile substances kehte hain, maslan lead, copper aur wrought iron.
Jo cheezein elastic limit par pohanchte hi toot jati hain unhen brittle (bhurbhuri) substances kehte hain, maslan glass aur high carbon steel. Beryllium, bismuth aur chromium bhi brittle metals hain.

blocks.title: Example 5.1
blocks.problem: 12 mm diameter wali steel ki wire ek lakri ke shahteer (log) se bandhi hai aur tractor use kheenchta hai. Log aur tractor ke darmiyan wire ki lambai 11 m hai. Log kheenchne ke liye 10,000 N force chahiye. Wire mein stress nikalein.
steps: Diameter 12 mm hai, to radius r = 6 mm = 6 × 10⁻³ m. Area A = πr² = 3.14 × (6 × 10⁻³ m)² = 1.13 × 10⁻⁴ m².
Tensile stress σ = F/A = 10,000 N / (3.14 × (6 × 10⁻³ m)²)
Wire ki lambai (11 m) stress nikalne mein kaam nahi aati; stress sirf force aur area par depend karta hai.

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Bhari steel ka bana jahaz pani par kyun tairta hai, jab ke chhota sa patthar doob jata hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser ka jawab: bhari steel ka jahaz kyun tairta hai jab ke chhota patthar doob jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Jahaz andar se khokhla (hollow) hai, is liye woh bohat sara pani hata (displace kar) sakta hai. Archimedes ke usool (5.7) ke mutabiq upthrust hataye gaye pani ke weight ke barabar hai; jahaz poora doobne se pehle apne weight ke barabar pani hata deta hai, is liye tairta hai. Chhota patthar thos (solid) hai; jo pani woh hatata hai us ka weight patthar ke weight se kam hai, is liye doob jata hai.

blocks.caption: Stress-strain curve ke points
rows: Hooke's law: strain stress ke proportional; A = proportional limit σₚ
elastic hai magar proportional nahi; B = yield point, elastic limit σₑ
plastic: hamesha ki deformation; C = ultimate tensile strength σᵤ
toot jana (fracture), fracture stress σf par

blocks.prompt: Stress-strain curve ka kaun sa hissa Hooke's law par chalta hai? Chhoti deformation mein stress/strain ki ratio constant rehti hai; bohat bari deformation mein is ratio ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Hissa OA (proportional limit tak). A ke baad curve mur jata hai, is liye ratio constant nahi rehti: A aur B ke darmiyan material elastic hai magar ratio kam hoti jati hai, aur yield point B ke baad thore se zyada stress se strain bohat barhta hai, is liye ratio tootne tak tezi se girti hai.

items: Ductile material ka curve: OA seedha (Hooke's law, proportional limit σₚ); OB elastic (B = yield point, elastic limit σₑ); BC plastic, C = UTS σᵤ; D = fracture.
Ductile: tootne se pehle plastic deformation (lead, copper, wrought iron). Brittle: elastic limit par hi toot jati hai (glass, high carbon steel, Be, Bi, Cr).
Example 5.1: σ = F/A = 88.46 × 10⁶ N m⁻² = 88.46 MPa.
